evidence.title: 《圆明园戏场探微》
evidence.summary: Survey of the gardens' theatres with sizes, from the three-storey stage of 1726 to the indoor stages of the Xianfeng period.

evidence.date: 咸丰六年 (1856) 正月二十二日
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样008-11号
evidence.summary: Plan of Shende Tang's interior later than the 1851 sheet, with the front bay rebuilt as an indoor stage; own page URL, shelf number and date not seen. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
